attempt_1.failure_reason: One quoted evidence span was a hybrid of two adjacent rows of the staged CSV and so equalled no line of any visible file. The span claimed inputs/data.csv:23-23 of case:769d1c65c50fd5c323ac and quoted 'BAR-022,Morex_Ref,BOPA1_2371-1163,B11,0.976,0,1'; line 23 of that file is 'BAR-022,Morex_Ref,BOPA1_2371-1163,B10,0.997,0,1' and line 24 is 'BAR-023,Morex_Ref,BOPA1_2371-1163,B11,0.976,1,1'. The span anchorer could not resolve it, and the frozen projector failed closed rather than record a quote that no file holds.

attempt_2.identity_binding: The fresh participant id keys the process capture directory, the call identity used as the session id, the transmitted prompt and the per-case packets, so attempt 2 could not reuse attempt 1's retained bytes. The pipeline moved attempt 1's packets into packets-primary-retired and rebuilt packets bound to the new reviewer agent.

ruling: Orchestrator ruling under the envelope-10 retired-attempt precedent: a review attempt that fails deterministic projection is retired, its evidence is retained, re-firing the retained call is forbidden, and a fresh reviewer identity may review the cases because no verdict from the retired attempt was ever recorded.
